steps.name: canonical-arrival-schema-and-legacy-migration
steps.summary: Established the canonical import/arrival/allocation/receipt schema, migration, canonical incoming loader, ProductVariant references, owner-scoped RLS foundations, immutable source rows, and compatibility RPC baseline. Focused and full tests, Prisma validation, lint, build, and isolated empty legacy-schema migration execution passed in the outer orchestrator. Remaining audited compatibility and behavioral-fixture work is isolated in step 1.

steps.name: canonical-persistence-hardening-and-behavioral-fixture
steps.summary: Hardened canonical manual/CSV creation with an explicit warehouse selector, moved legacy counter synchronization behind a private SECURITY DEFINER trigger boundary, tightened receipt transaction consistency and one-transaction evidence linkage, restored receipt outbox writes, and added the behavioral runner skeleton. Focused/full tests and outer production build passed. Outer audit found the fixture had no representative rows and no psql portability; step 2 owns those acceptance gaps.

steps.name: executable-legacy-migration-proof
steps.summary: Replaced the empty behavioral fixture with two-user representative legacy rows (draft states, repeated variants, deterministic multi-warehouse evidence, and overage), added executable assertions for source/incoming/evidence/RLS/immutability compatibility, and made the proof runner accept a supplied psql or the dedicated Supabase container while preserving target safety. Reworked legacy transaction assignment to link each complete transaction to at most one repeated row and retain deterministic warehouse receipts while recording ambiguous expected remainders. Focused and full tests, Prisma validation, and lint passed. Docker access was denied in this environment, so the disposable-container command could not be executed here; build reached Next font fetch and failed only because the sandbox cannot reach Google Fonts.

steps.name: supplier-sku-mapping-and-audit
steps.summary: Added template-independent exact supplier SKU normalization, active mapping identity, immutable audit evidence, trusted confirm/reassign/deactivate RPCs, legacy same-target collapse/conflict deactivation, targeted canonical source snapshot updates, and owner-scoped RLS/grants in a forward migration. Inbound preview now performs supplier-only exact active lookup and receipt code no longer creates mappings. Added server actions and an optional supplier SKU pre-map control in the existing 상품 관리 SKU modal. Focused and full tests (239) passed; Prisma validation and lint passed (four pre-existing warnings). The behavioral runner could not start because this sandbox denies tsx IPC socket creation; production build reached Next font fetch and failed only because Google Fonts is unreachable in the sandbox.

steps.name: supplier-mapping-migration-and-receipt-hardening
steps.summary: Hardened supplier SKU migration ordering by normalizing and collapsing legacy template mappings before the active exact unique index, with complete audit evidence and a dynamic drop for PostgreSQL-truncated legacy constraints. Confirm now locks and validates every targeted source row atomically; mapping write RPCs are authenticated-only and mapping history uses restrictive supplier/ProductVariant deletion behavior. Replaced the installed legacy draft receipt RPC with a trusted atomic mapping-free implementation, and made schema.sql executable with matching collapse, policies, helpers, RPCs, and grants. Added migration-chain fixtures for same-target/conflicting legacy duplicates, reconfirm after deactivate, source-row rollback, receipt compatibility, isolation, and immutable audit. Focused/full tests (240), Prisma validation, and lint passed (four pre-existing warnings). Disposable DB proof could not run because Docker socket access is denied; build reached Next font fetch and failed only because Google Fonts is unreachable in the sandbox.

steps.name: import-deduplication-revisions-and-promotion
steps.summary: Added immutable logical import evidence with edge-Unicode shipment normalization, user-wide SHA-256 file identity, ordered source-row snapshots, immutable revisions/supersession guards, exact mapping review blockers, and trusted atomic promotion into one FactoryArrival item/allocation per source row. The existing template surface now requires an external shipment number at save time and computes the original-byte hash server-side. Focused and full tests (242), Prisma validation, lint (four existing warnings), and diff checks passed. Disposable migration/RLS proof could not run because psql and Docker access are unavailable; production build reached the existing Google Fonts network failure.

steps.name: import-revision-proof-and-review-hardening
steps.summary: Hardened trusted import registration and promotion with exact active mapping resolution, lowercase SHA-256 validation, logical-shipment advisory serialization, template/version relationship validation, direct-insert revocations, legacy duplicate-hash exception preservation, and raw quantity evidence preservation. Extended the disposable behavioral runner and fixture with RPC-level revision/promotion assertions. Focused/full tests (244), Prisma validation, lint, and diff checks passed; the behavioral runner is blocked by sandbox tsx IPC permissions, and build reaches the existing Google Fonts network failure.

steps.name: first-upload-mapping-review-and-promotion-ui
steps.summary: Implemented and tested the reachable first-upload review and separate warehouse-promotion flow, plus moved duplicate-hash reconciliation before the unique index, removed colliding policies, and corrected behavioral fixture custom setting names/failure reset. Focused and full tests (244), lint, Prisma validation, and diff checks passed. The dedicated behavioral command remains blocked by sandbox tsx IPC permissions and build by unavailable Google Fonts. This step remains blocked because the required fresh supabase/schema.sql executable-RPC equivalence has not been completed or proven in this session.

steps.name: executable-import-bootstrap-and-db-proof
steps.summary: Qualified OUT-column-colliding import revision references in the forward RPCs, added executable checked-in schema register/promote RPC bodies and grants, and expanded the disposable proof with cross-owner hash, direct-insert, immutable evidence, mapping/forged-id, and invalid-row assertions. The inbound sheet now keeps warehouse selection out of preview/review-save and reveals it only for second-stage promotion. Focused and full tests, Prisma validation, lint, and diff checks passed. The dedicated behavioral runner remains blocked in this sandbox by tsx IPC socket permissions; production build reaches the existing unavailable Google Fonts network failure. The outer Docker harness must execute the fresh migration/schema proof.

steps.name: allocation-partial-receipt-variance-and-correction
steps.summary: Implemented trusted remainder-only warehouse reallocation, multi-row partial receipt with database-derived idempotency, overage and shortage evidence, closure-linked late follow-up receipts, and immutable full-line corrections with compensating transactions and latest absolute outbox targets. Added reservation/reversal serialization, owner RLS, forward/fresh-schema parity, server actions, and executable PostgreSQL proofs for 30→20+10 splits, atomic receipts, retry conflicts, incoming balances, follow-up linkage, and correction restoration. Dedicated legacy-chain and fresh schema execution, 247 tests, Prisma validation, lint, build, and diff checks pass. Final reachable workspace controls are isolated to the next integration step.

steps.name: canonical-arrival-workspace-integration
steps.summary: Integrated the canonical arrival workspace with allocation-level remainders, 30→20+10 warehouse splits, stable-id multi-row partial receipts, overage evidence, shortage closure, closure-linked follow-up, full-line correction, canonical status labels, repeated source-row evidence, and the two-stage Excel review/promotion launcher. Inventory now shows warehouse-specific committed/incoming values, including zero-on-hand variants, with arrival deep links and refresh after promotion. First-upload product creation opens separately so the local draft remains intact, then refreshes product choices in place. Full 251 tests, Prisma validation, lint (four pre-existing warnings), production build, and diff checks pass; Step 9 already proved the dedicated legacy-chain Docker behavior and fresh schema execution.

steps.name: completion-integrity-and-ui-ownership-correction
steps.summary: Corrected Harness completion integrity by preserving per-attempt evidence, rejecting non-zero child exits despite claimed completion, running declared argv acceptance outside the child, and requiring successful current evidence for corrective supersession. Review context now resolves the current feature branch and validates phase evidence without a nonexistent command. Sourcing navigation exposes factories and arrivals, /sourcing redirects to arrivals, supplier Excel review remains arrival-owned, inventory keeps direct manual inbound, legacy manual arrival creation is secondary disclosure, and supplier import now requires file review instead of editable/paste-style rows. Inbound terminology is committed in product/ADR docs and CLAUDE.md remains pointer-only. Harness-owned acceptance passed: harness tests, review tests, 256 application tests, lint (four existing warnings), and production build.

steps.name: inbound-domain-contract-gap-closure
steps.summary: Closed the persisted-review and receiving-contract gaps: incomplete/unmapped rows remain immutable evidence and promotion remains the trusted blocker; receipt and follow-up operations carry a Korea-local editable business date through canonical payloads, idempotency and transaction dates; allocation move-all is reachable with a required reason and audit evidence; the arrival workspace keeps receipt dates and drafts scoped to the selected arrival or closure. Loader output now exposes receipt business dates. Forward migrations and fresh schema were updated together for the receipt date, review persistence, audit table, and move-all RPC. Direct acceptance passed: 259 tests, lint (four existing warnings), Prisma validation, production build, and diff check. The outer Harness still owns disposable database/fresh-schema behavioral execution.
